releaseNotes: Improves offline word study: when exact verse-level Hebrew/Greek interlinear data is unavailable, the reader now searches the precached 85-entry curated word-study library and displays related entries with original script, contextual gloss, references and interpretive cautions. It clearly distinguishes related studies from verified verse-level matches. Includes 122 contextual commentary entries and 125 unique faith-response references. Refreshes the offline cache.
